title: The common boundary of four words
statement: For any four finite Boolean words and any position $j\in\mathbb N$, all four words have no symbol at position $j$ exactly when their maximum length is at most $j$.
replaced: For every four comparator words and every position $j$, all four aligned reads at $j$ are blank exactly when the common maximum width is at most $j$, so a word attaining the maximum prevents an early return.
